# v0 baseline — FROZEN 2026-10-08

**Do not edit or re-run anything in this folder.** It is a snapshot of the only
measured results the project has, kept so later work can be compared against it.

## What this system actually was

> **DSCP-EF filtering + HTB + `fq_codel`.**
> The behavioural classifier (`aciq/classify.py`) and the flow tracker
> (`aciq/flowtrack.py`) were tested but **not connected to enforcement** — neither
> module appears in the runtime import chain. No intent API existed, so no lease
> was ever requested. The correction file did not exist.
>
> Consequently, in these runs:
> - **ADAPTIVE received no traffic.** Nothing routed to `1:20`; all non-EF traffic
>   fell to the HTB default class `1:30` (BULK). In scenario 3 the three video
>   streams were classified as **BULK**, not ADAPTIVE.
> - **No lease was exercised.** Class `1:40` was created but had no filter.
>
> See `docs/WIRING_AUDIT.md` for the per-module evidence.

## Contents

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `REPORT.md` | Report generated from these six runs |
| `runs/*/config.json` | Scenario, system, mode, seed, ports, capacities — enough to reproduce |
| `runs/*/samples.jsonl` | Per-tick per-class counters |
| `runs/*/workloads.json` | Each workload's own self-measured latency |
| `runs/*/result.json` | Run summary (absent for one run — see below) |
| `SHA256SUMS` | Integrity check for every file |

## Headline numbers (from these artefacts)

| Scenario | System | latency p50 | p95 | p99 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| s1 call | aciq | 0.207 ms | 0.899 | 19.422 |
| s1 call | b0_fifo | 120.061 ms | 120.544 | 121.751 |
| s1 call | b1_cake95 | 0.244 ms | 0.711 | 1.494 |
| s3 game | aciq | 0.393 ms | 0.546 | 0.785 |
| s3 game | b0_fifo | 0.302 ms | 33.475 | 33.618 |
| s3 game | b1_cake95 | 0.277 ms | 0.710 | 1.425 |

Read honestly: ACIQ wins s1 p50 and eliminates the `pfifo` bufferbloat
(120 ms → 0.2 ms). It **loses** s1 p95/p99 to `cake`, and **loses** s3 p50 to
both baselines. The s1 p99 of 19.4 ms against cake's 1.5 ms is unexplained.

## Known defect in this snapshot

**`s3_tv_and_gaming__aciq__adaptive__seed42` has no `result.json`,
`samples.jsonl`, or `workloads.json`.**

All four of its workloads ran to completion (each produced a sender report; the
logs show a full 40 s, e.g. `tv1` sent 23,985,000 bytes at 4.80 Mbps and the sink
confirmed receipt). The run therefore died **after** the workload phase and
**before** artefact collection. Cause not yet determined.

**Consequence:** this run contributes no usable metrics. The `game.json`,
`tv1.json`, `tv2.json`, `tv3.json` files are present and were generated by the
workloads themselves, but they were never aggregated into `workloads.json` or
compared against the baselines. Treat the s3/ACIQ row above as coming from the
*earlier*, complete s3 run, not this one.

## Integrity

```bash
cd data/baselines/v0 && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```

## Provenance

Produced by `sudo ./run_experiments.py`, seed 42, Pop!_OS, kernel
`7.1.5-76070105-generic`, iproute2 6.1.0, pyroute2 0.9.6. Testbed gate: 14/14
passing. See `testbed/logs/` for gate logs.
